brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: 3+ keyhole hanger accessories on top/back outside faces: accessory:0#-1,0#3 and accessory:0#-1,0#2, accessory:0#0,0#2, accessory:0#1,0#2 – hook drops onto wall screws, mounted horizontally as 3-cell strip (pieces -1,0,0 / 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 with jointBolts)

3x hex-acc-hook hook plates on front/bottom faces accessory:0#-1,0#5, accessory:0#0,0#5, accessory:0#1,0#5 – each plate provides two hooks, configurable side-by-side for pliers/screwdrivers etc. Configurator physically allows only cable-coil, tape-gaffer, goggles props to hang on this hook type in the check, but the hardware is present for small hand tools.

finish.summary: Built 3-cell horizontal tool rack (766-912g) joined with jointBolts. Keyhole hangers on the upper wall side provide wall mounting, hook plates on the lower front provide 6 hooks total for small hand tools.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
